description.en: We started driving and drove a few more minutes. Then we stopped and had to get out of the vehicle. About 20 minutes later to the front, another object that looked similar lit up in the sky over the top of another hillside slightly to the right of front. It appeared to be several miles away. It only lit up for a second or two and then was gone again. While it was lit, it appeared three red lights flew out of and away from it. They seemed evenly spaced apart and moved pretty fast, quickly disappearing from sight. At the same time the orange light lit up, there appeared to be a flash from over the horizon to the left. The flash lit up the sky pretty well, though very briefly.
description.fr: Nous sommes repartis et avons roulé quelques minutes de plus, puis nous nous sommes arrêtés et avons dû descendre du véhicule. Une vingtaine de minutes plus tard, devant nous, un autre objet semblable s'est allumé dans le ciel au-dessus d'une autre colline, un peu à droite. Il semblait à plusieurs miles. Il ne s'est allumé qu'une seconde ou deux, puis a disparu. Pendant qu'il était allumé, trois lumières rouges ont semblé en sortir et s'en éloigner, régulièrement espacées, assez vite, disparaissant rapidement. Au même moment, il y a eu comme un éclair au-delà de l'horizon, sur la gauche, qui a bien éclairé le ciel, très brièvement.

time.rationale: the second of the two evenings (witness 1: "The second night"), taken as 2023-10-15: the one evening of October 2023 with a freshly launched Starlink train to the south-east between 7 and 9 pm, as witness 4 saw on his second evening; "About 20 minutes later"; witness 5 says 19:18

durationSeconds.rationale: "It only lit up for a second or two", the red lights "quickly disappearing"

value.name: White Rock Road, Desert National Wildlife Refuge, Nevada

place.rationale: the place is withheld ("a sensitive national security site in the western United States"). Working hypothesis of RR0: the Nevada National Security Site, over which drones were detected on three days in October 2023 (Wall Street Journal), and the Desert National Wildlife Refuge north of Las Vegas; witness 5 turned off a highway towards a "Wildlife National park (?name)" onto a rough unpaved road, and saw the light "ahead and slightly to our right" over "a distinctive peak in the ridge line", which AARO measured at about 1,050 m. White Rock Road in the refuge, driven west, has a peak on the skyline 1,090 m away ahead and to the right (bearing 321, 5.5° high), found by a search of the 10 m USGS relief for summits standing out 0.9 to 1.3 km from the refuge's tracks; one candidate among several; witness 1 was in the same vehicle as witness 5 (AARO: USPER5 and USPER6 saw the "fiery orb" together); they had walked on a little: the same place is kept
